configuration.inactive_lanes: Unobserved inactive C-shim fields are concretized to zero; no ISA-policy refinement claim. The output contract observes only the first VL lanes.

integer_rules.shl7: retain low16bits of a*128; no saturating left shift
integer_rules.neon_qrdmulh: sat16(floor((2*a*b+32768)/65536)); doubled mathematical product is not truncated32
integer_rules.negated_multiplier: signed16(unsigned32(0-unsigned32(raw_multiplier))); defined for every int32 raw multiplier
integer_rules.rounding_ties: SQRDMULH and the selected RNU conversion both use ties toward positive infinity; they are not ties-away-from-zero or RNE.
integer_rules.parameter_projection: All four raw int32 fields preserved: z=signed16(raw_z), o=signed16(raw_o); choose positive multiplier when signed16(z-x)<0, otherwise negative; negate chosen multiplier in unsigned32 and narrow16.
integer_rules.neon_mask: Per signed16 compare, canonical0 or65535; only canonical masks are needed by the public kernel. qlr_neon_canonical is proved by actual comparator C closure, never assumed of public inputs.
integer_rules.neon_select: For canonical mask65535 choose first signed16 source; for0 choose second. This is the restriction of official per-bit BSL semantics to comparator-generated masks, not a claim of arbitrary-mask ISA bit-select support.
integer_rules.rvv_compare_splat_merge: Active lane signed16 less-than gives boolean0/1; splat negative seed, then vmerge selects positive seed when mask1 and preserves negative seed otherwise. Fixed e16m4, no arbitrary VLEN claim.

source_expression_composition.memory_bridge: Six universal full/undef-array versus byte-cell equivalences; initialized UChar/Char conversion uses bounded signed roundtrip, never undef-to-initialized conversion.
source_expression_composition.ownership: Borrowed input vector cells are preserved. Direct by-value caller recovery and indirect adapters with duplicate output ownership were rejected and archived. Native tests do not replace C/Coq proof.
source_expression_composition.boundary: No general theorem for side-effectful macro arguments, ISA/ABI compilation refinement or termination.
